plugin-data.name: Static Site Generator
plugin-data.description: Generate a fully static HTML copy of the site to bl-content/static-build/. Useful for archiving, mirroring, or hosting the site without PHP.

sgj-section-action-subtitle: Renders every public URL, copies referenced assets, rewrites links to document-relative paths, and writes the result to bl-content/static-build/. The admin area, drafts, and the bl-content databases are never included.
sgj-confirm-body: This will render every public page and overwrite anything currently in bl-content/static-build/. The build runs synchronously — keep this tab open until it finishes.
sgj-loading-body: Rendering pages and copying assets. Please don’t close this tab — the page will refresh automatically when the build finishes.
sgj-exclude-paths-tip: One path per line. Any URL whose path starts with one of these is skipped (admin and bl-content/databases are always skipped).
sgj-build-locked: Another build appears to be in progress. If this is wrong, remove the lock file from the workspace and try again.
sgj-build-no-output-dir: Could not create the output directory.
sgj-howitworks-1: Pages are rendered in-process by Bludit itself — the plugin does not make any HTTP requests, so the build works the same way locally, inside Vagrant, and in production.
sgj-howitworks-2: HTML pages are written as path/index.html so clean URLs keep working; all absolute and root-relative links are rewritten to document-relative paths.
sgj-howitworks-3: Referenced theme, upload, and other public assets are copied verbatim from disk; anything under the admin URI or bl-content/databases is always skipped.
sgj-howitworks-4: Drafts, scheduled pages, and any path you list under Exclude paths are never written to the build.
